strategy.text: Compose every release body from the changelog section plus stable text, and enforce it on both sides: the publisher refuses bad sections before upload, the archive checker requires equality with the source. The flowchart shows composition, upload, download, and both checks.

what-the-diff-actually-built.text: Rewritten stable text, section extraction with loud refusal, extended publisher checks with eleven double-backed cases, the sibling archive check rewritten to equality plus wording, and the archive README row.

verification-as-shipped.text: Docs checks green, release-check cases green, both archives verified, packaged shell checks green, negative controls refuse, restored candidate passes.

file-fence-what-the-merge-touched.text: Five files: the two archive texts and three release tools. No Lean, validator, runner, workflow, or check-setting edits.

slice.text: One slice: versioned release bodies with usable archive instructions, shipped as a single commit.
